title: Objectwise scalar fibre components and fixed heart associators
statement: Fix a field $k$, a prime $\ell$ invertible in $k$, and a coherent continuous rational realization family $R$. Use the separated finite-type $k$-bases, their actual localized rational hearts and scalar functors, normalized geometric fibres and pullback data of [def-per-adic-fibre-comparison-data], [def-per-adic-fibre-coherence-data], [def-per-adic-normalized-fibre-data] and [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-pullback], and the actual finite scalar quotients and reduction-cone maps of [def-zl-normalized-adic-fibre-limit-data]. For a normalized fibre family $\omega$, define ScalarFibreComponents to be one isomorphism at each heart object $F$, finite coefficient embedding $i:A\to B$, base $X$ and geometric point $x$, from $\omega_{B,x}(T_iF)$ to $B\otimes_{A,i}\omega_{A,x}(F)$. Require exactly the universal degree-zero presentation germ normalization and the universal adapted-chart finite-quotient, integral reduction-cone and localized pure-tensor normalization of the scalar assertion. No naturality on heart arrows or identity, composition or mixed coherence is included. Define scalarHeartUnit, scalarHeartComp and scalarHeartMixed by componentwise restriction of the specified raw scalar unit, associator and $R$ mixed comparison to the full heart. Given a normalized pullback $\alpha$ and objectwise components $d$, define ScalarFibreCoherence to be the three equations for $d$ using these fixed heart maps: scalar identity, scalar composition, and commutation with $\alpha$ in the mixed square. These are data and properties; no existence or coherence is asserted.
